regions.name: Mosswake Valley
regions.landscape: Steep mountains, rocky cliffs, deep valleys, flowing fresh-water rivers, waterfalls and beautiful lakes. Dense tall fir and cedar forests, leafy woodland, moss, ferns, wildflowers and sunny marshmallow-tree clearings. Snow belongs to the high peaks; the inhabited valley stays green.
regions.city: A broad lake-and-river capital of timber and river stone, with terraced streets, bell towers, working docks, bridges, gardens and a large market. A furnished inn, library, workshops, homes and civic bell hall make it a place to live, not a backdrop. Brindlewick remains a separate friendly starting village, and Frostharbor remains a recognizable mountain settlement.

regions.name: S’morewood
regions.landscape: A huge living food forest: distinct marshmallow trees, segmented chocolate-bar trees, graham-cracker trees, cocoa vines, berry shrubs, cream mushrooms and herbs. The cola river begins at the summit of towering Fizzpeak, falls through several foaming cascades, and meanders through the forest into a brown cola lake. Fresh water has a separate catchment.
regions.city: Expand familiar Alderhaven into a lively forest capital with cocoa-wood framing, graham-colored masonry, sheltered orchard streets, bakeries, ingredient markets and bridges over fizzy brown cola canals. Food-shaped details stay practical enough to be believable buildings. Furnish bakeries with ovens and ingredient stores, homes with beds and kitchens, and taverns with working dining spaces.

regions.name: Windbell Plains
regions.landscape: Truly broad flat or gently rolling terrain, open sightlines and very few abrupt height changes. Occasional wind-shaped trees, tall grasses, flax, windbell flowers and low scrub; narrow streams and small lakes. Sparse trees should never turn this region into a forest.
regions.city: Grow Ironbell into a spacious trade capital with windmills, grain halls, canals, a huge bronze bell civic hall, craft guilds, caravan yards, markets and residential streets. Homes, guild workshops, inns and granaries are furnished according to their jobs. Keep the approach roads gentle, with no sudden mountain wall around the city.

regions.name: Sunspire Dunes
regions.landscape: Massive dunes, rocky escarpments, rare oases and warned sandstorms. Twisted thorn trees, cacti, succulents, palms near water and hardy scrub give the desert its own plant language. Two separately explorable pyramids have different internal structures and puzzles. No marshmallow trees grow here.
regions.city: Expand Sunspire Bazaar into an oasis capital of honey sandstone, domes, wind towers, shaded bazaars, courtyard homes and water gardens. Interiors use rugs, carved screens, cushions, ceramic water jars, cooking areas and stocked stalls. Safe sheltered routes lead out toward dunes, caves and pyramids.

regions.name: Ashfall Caldera
regions.landscape: Active volcanoes, flowing lava, deep ravines, smog and falling ash. Black-bark trees, obsidian grasses, ember fungi, copper lichens and heat-adapted scrub. This entire region is unsettled wilderness: no capital, towns, villages, inhabited trade posts or friendly settlement hubs.
regions.city: The proposed volcanic capital is removed. A continuous basalt wilderness trail crosses between Prismere and the desert, with durable bridges over ravines, switchbacks and clearly marked safe footing around lava. Side paths reach natural caves, floating-island access points and abandoned or hostile dungeon ruins. Keep those ruins distinct from inhabited towns; no merchants, residential districts or disguised settlement outposts are added here.

regions.name: Hollowmourn
regions.landscape: A deliberately smaller, dense, dead haunted forest: bare twisted trunks, black root tangles, dead ferns, pale grave flowers, brittle thorn shrubs, cold fog, crows and unsettling sounds. Scares come from silhouettes, stalking and atmosphere; the default proposal avoids graphic gore. No bustling capital belongs here.
regions.city: Blackthorn Keep stands on top of a steep hill. A long winding path makes several switchbacks from a broken iron gate, passes an abandoned watch lodge and crumbling shrine, and finally crosses the castle drawbridge. Gusts, dead branches and intermittent views of the towers make the climb memorable. The route is physically walkable both ways, with rest ledges and clear footing.

regions.name: Prismere
regions.landscape: The surprise region is an enormous ancient impact basin, not just a crystal cave. Mint, lilac and rose crystal groves rise like living trees beside mirror lakes and amethyst escarpments. Bell-like crystal grasses, quartz reeds, opal moss and glassleaf shrubs catch gentle rainbow light. Natural resonance makes wind audible; avoid constant harsh flashing.
regions.city: Prismarion rises on concentric stone-and-crystal terraces around one enormous suspended Aurora Prism. Warm occupied homes, jewel-cutters, bridges, canal markets, gardens and an observatory balance the extraordinary centerpiece. Furnished houses still have beds, kitchens, tables, books and tools; crystal is a material and cultural identity, not an excuse for empty rooms.

towns.name: Brindlewick
towns.role: Keep the familiar starting village: timber-and-stone cottages, a village green, general supplies, a welcoming inn and nearby camp clearings.

towns.name: Frostharbor
towns.role: Preserve the mountain settlement: steep-roofed timber homes, a sheltered trading yard, guides and warm furnished interiors beneath the snowy peaks.

towns.name: Fizzbridge
towns.role: An orchard town beside a bridge over the cola river, with fizzy-drink stalls, ingredient storage and lookout paths toward Fizzpeak.

towns.name: Graham Glen
towns.role: A graham-tree farming town with warm tan masonry, cracker orchards, harvest yards, furnished farmhouses and a communal bake oven.

towns.name: Reedford
towns.role: A low stream-crossing town of reed gardens, fishing piers, farm cottages and gentle roads, preserving open plains sightlines.

towns.name: Millbrook
towns.role: A small lakeside milling town with a watermill, storehouses, market carts and cottages along a gently curving brook.

towns.name: Oasis Rest
towns.role: An oasis town with shaded courtyard homes, palms, a furnished caravan inn and reliable water supplies on the southern route.

towns.name: Saffron Cross
towns.role: A sandstone caravan town at a road junction, with wind shelters, pack-animal yards, spice traders and furnished homes.

towns.name: Opalbrook
towns.role: A lake-edge town of pearl-toned stone homes, crystal reed gardens, fishing walkways and occupied furnished cottages.

towns.name: Chimecross
towns.role: A crystal-craft town at the northern road junction, with bell gardens, gemcutters, stocked workshops and a small inn.
